description: This file defines the NetworkFragment class, which is a headless Fragment responsible for managing network requests asynchronously in an Android application. It includes methods to start, cancel, and handle network requests, along with an inner AsyncTask class, DownloadTask, to perform network operations.

classes.name: NetworkFragment
classes.description: A headless Fragment that manages asynchronous network requests using an inner AsyncTask class, designed to survive configuration changes and provide a callback interface to update the UI.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Static method to retrieve or create an instance of NetworkFragment associated with a FragmentManager and URL.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the fragment, retrieves URL argument, and sets it to retain instance across configuration changes.

methods.name: onAttach
methods.description: Attaches the callback interface to the host context.

methods.name: onDetach
methods.description: Clears the callback reference when fragment is detached.

methods.name: onDestroy
methods.description: Cancels ongoing download tasks when the fragment is destroyed.

methods.name: cancelDownload
methods.description: Cancels the ongoing download task if any.
